\begin{aligned} E[\log p(\beta_{kj})]-E[\log q(\beta_{kj}\mid\delta_{kj})] ={}& E[\delta_{kj}] E\left[ \log p(\beta_{kj}) -\log q(\beta_{kj}\mid\delta_{kj}=1) \mid\delta_{kj}=1 \right] \\ ={}& -\frac{E[\delta_{kj}]}{2} \left[ \tau(\mu_{\beta_{kj}}^2+\sigma_{\beta_{kj}}^2) - 1 - \log(\tau\sigma_{\beta_{kj}}^2) \right]. \end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned} E[\log p(\beta_{kj})] - E[\log q(\beta_{kj},\delta_{kj})] ={}& E[\log p(\beta_{kj})] - E[\log q(\beta_{kj}\mid\delta_{kj})] - E[\log q(\delta_{kj})] \\ ={}&  - \frac{E[\delta_{kj}]}{2} \left[ \tau(\mu_{\beta_{kj}}^2+\sigma_{\beta_{kj}}^2) - 1 - \log(\tau\sigma_{\beta_{kj}}^2) \right] -\Big[E[\delta_{kj}]\log E[\delta_{kj}] + (1-E[\delta_{kj}])\log(1-E[\delta_{kj}])\Big]. \end{aligned} 
$$

### **5.10** $E[\log q(z_{ij},v_{ij})]$

Since $q(z_{ij}, v_{ij}) = q(v_{ij})q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij})$, we have

$$
E[\log q(z_{ij}, v_{ij})] = E[\log q(v_{ij})] + E[\log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij})].
$$

Then,

$$
\begin{aligned} E[\log q(v_{ij})] ={}& q(v_{ij}=0)\log q(v_{ij}=0) + q(v_{ij}=1)\log q(v_{ij}=1) \\ ={}& (1-E[v_{ij}]) \log(1-E[v_{ij}]) + E[v_{ij}]\log E[v_{ij}]. \end{aligned}
$$

Also,

$$
\begin{aligned} E[\log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij})] ={}& q(v_{ij}=0) E[\log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=0)] + q(v_{ij}=1) E[\log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1)] \\ ={}& (1-E[v_{ij}]) E[\log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=0)] + E[v_{ij}] E[\log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1)]. \end{aligned}
$$

For $v_{ij}=0$, $q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=0) = \delta_0(z_{ij})$. So,

$$
E[\log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=0)] = \log 1 = 0.
$$

For $v_{ij}=1$, $q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1) = \operatorname{Gamma}(a_{z_{ij}}, b_{z_{ij}})$. Hence,

$$
q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1) = \frac{b_{z_{ij}}^{a_{z_{ij}}}}{\Gamma(a_{z_{ij}})} z_{ij}^{a_{z_{ij}}-1} \exp(-b_{z_{ij}}z_{ij}),
$$

$$
E[\log z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1] = \Psi(a_{z_{ij}}) - \log b_{z_{ij}}, \quad  \quad E[z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1] = \frac{a_{z_{ij}}}{b_{z_{ij}}}.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned} \log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1) ={}& a_{z_{ij}}\log b_{z_{ij}} - \log\Gamma(a_{z_{ij}}) + (a_{z_{ij}}-1)\log z_{ij} - b_{z_{ij}}z_{ij}. \end{aligned}
$$

Taking the expectation,

$$
\begin{aligned} E[\log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1)] ={}& a_{z_{ij}}\log b_{z_{ij}} - \log\Gamma(a_{z_{ij}}) + (a_{z_{ij}}-1) E[\log z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1] - b_{z_{ij}} E[z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1] \\ ={}& a_{z_{ij}}\log b_{z_{ij}} - \log\Gamma(a_{z_{ij}}) + (a_{z_{ij}}-1) \left[ \Psi(a_{z_{ij}}) - \log b_{z_{ij}} \right] - b_{z_{ij}} \frac{a_{z_{ij}}}{b_{z_{ij}}} \\ ={}& a_{z_{ij}}\log b_{z_{ij}} - \log\Gamma(a_{z_{ij}}) + (a_{z_{ij}}-1) \left[ \Psi(a_{z_{ij}}) - \log b_{z_{ij}} \right] - a_{z_{ij}}. \end{aligned}$$

Thus,

$$
\begin{aligned} E[\log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij})] ={}& E[v_{ij}] E[\log q(z_{ij}\mid v_{ij}=1)] \\ ={}& E[v_{ij}] \Big[ a_{z_{ij}}\log b_{z_{ij}} - \log\Gamma(a_{z_{ij}}) +(a_{z_{ij}}-1) \left( \Psi(a_{z_{ij}}) - \log b_{z_{ij}} \right) - a_{z_{ij}} \Big]. \end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned} E[\log q(z_{ij}, v_{ij})] ={}& (1-E[v_{ij}]) \log(1-E[v_{ij}]) + E[v_{ij}]\log E[v_{ij}] \\ &+ E[v_{ij}] \Big[ a_{z_{ij}}\log b_{z_{ij}} - \log\Gamma(a_{z_{ij}}) + (a_{z_{ij}}-1) \left( \Psi(a_{z_{ij}}) - \log b_{z_{ij}} \right) - a_{z_{ij}} \Big]. \end{aligned} 
$$

### **5.11** $E[\log q(a_{ik})]$

For $q(a_{ik}) = \text{Gamma}(a_{a_{ik}}, b_{a_{ik}})$, $$
q(a_{ik}) = \frac{b_{a_{ik}}^{a_{a_{ik}}}}{\Gamma(a_{a_{ik}})} a_{ik}^{a_{a_{ik}} - 1} \exp(-b_{a_{ik}} a_{ik}),
$$ so $$
\log q(a_{ik}) = a_{a_{ik}} \log b_{a_{ik}} - \log \Gamma(a_{a_{ik}}) + (a_{a_{ik}} - 1)\log a_{ik} - b_{a_{ik}} a_{ik}.
$$ Then, $$
\begin{aligned}
E[\log q(a_{ik})] &= a_{a_{ik}} \log b_{a_{ik}} - \log \Gamma(a_{a_{ik}}) + (a_{a_{ik}} - 1)E[\log a_{ik}] - b_{a_{ik}} E[a_{ik}] \\
&= a_{a_{ik}} \log b_{a_{ik}} - \log \Gamma(a_{a_{ik}}) + (a_{a_{ik}} - 1)\left[\Psi(a_{a_{ik}}) - \log b_{a_{ik}}\right] - b_{a_{ik}} \frac{a_{a_{ik}}}{b_{a_{ik}}} \\
&= a_{a_{ik}} \log b_{a_{ik}} - \log \Gamma(a_{a_{ik}}) + (a_{a_{ik}} - 1)\left[\Psi(a_{a_{ik}}) - \log b_{a_{ik}}\right] - a_{a_{ik}}.
\end{aligned}
$$ Combining $E[\log p(a_{ik})]$ and $E[\log q(a_{ik})]$, $$
E[\log p(a_{ik})] - E[\log q(a_{ik})] = -\log \Gamma(\alpha_a) + \alpha_a \log \alpha_a + \log \Gamma(a_{a_{ik}}) - a_{a_{ik}} \log b_{a_{ik}} + (\alpha_a - a_{a_{ik}})\left[\Psi(a_{a_{ik}}) - \log b_{a_{ik}}\right] - \frac{\alpha_a a_{a_{ik}}}{b_{a_{ik}}} + a_{a_{ik}}.
$$

### **5.12 Complete ELBO**

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{ELBO}(q) \gtrsim &\sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^J \Bigg\{ \frac{1}{2} f''(E[n]) \operatorname{Var}(n) + E[v_{ij}]\bigg[\log \Gamma(x_{ij} + \rho) - \log \Gamma(x_{ij} + 1) - \log \Gamma(\rho) + \rho \log \rho + x_{ij} \log(1 - u_{ij}) \\
&\quad - (\rho + x_{ij}) \log \xi_{ij} - \frac{\rho + x_{ij}}{\xi_{ij}} \left\{\rho + (1 - u_{ij})\frac{a_{z_{ij}}}{b_{z_{ij}}} - \xi_{ij}\right\} \\
&\quad - \log \Gamma(\gamma e^{E[n]}) + \gamma e^{E[n]} \log \gamma + \{x_{ij} + \gamma e^{E[n]} - a_{z_{ij}}\}\left\{\Psi(a_{z_{ij}}) - \log b_{z_{ij}}\right\} \\
&\quad - \gamma \frac{a_{z_{ij}}}{b_{z_{ij}}} - a_{z_{ij}} \log b_{z_{ij}} + \log \Gamma(a_{z_{ij}}) + a_{z_{ij}}\bigg] \\
&\quad + \bigg[E[v_{ij}]E[\log \eta_j] + (1 - E[v_{ij}])E[\log(1 - \eta_j)] - E[v_{ij}]\log E[v_{ij}] - (1 - E[v_{ij}])\log(1 - E[v_{ij}])\bigg] \Bigg\} \\
&+ \sum_{k=1}^K \sum_{j=1}^J \Bigg[ -\frac{E[\delta_{kj}]}{2} \left\{\tau(\mu_{\beta_{kj}}^2 + \sigma_{\beta_{kj}}^2) - 1 - \log(\tau \sigma_{\beta_{kj}}^2)\right\} - E[\delta_{kj}]\log E[\delta_{kj}] - (1 - E[\delta_{kj}])\log(1 - E[\delta_{kj}]) \\
&\quad + E[\delta_{kj}]\left\{E[\log \psi_k] + E[\log \phi_j]\right\} + (1 - E[\delta_{kj}])\Big[\xi_{kj}E[\log(1 - \psi_k)] + (1 - \xi_{kj})E[\log \psi_k] \\
&\quad + (1 - \xi_{kj})E[\log(1 - \phi_j)] + H(\xi_{kj})\Big] \Bigg] \\
&+ \sum_{k=1}^K \Big[ -\log B(\alpha_\psi, \beta_\psi) + \log B(a_{\psi_k}, b_{\psi_k}) + (\alpha_\psi - a_{\psi_k})E[\log \psi_k] + (\beta_\psi - b_{\psi_k})E[\log(1 - \psi_k)] \Big] \\
&+ \sum_{j=1}^J \Big[ -\log B(\alpha_\phi, \beta_\phi) + \log B(a_{\phi_j}, b_{\phi_j}) + (\alpha_\phi - a_{\phi_j})E[\log \phi_j] + (\beta_\phi - b_{\phi_j})E[\log(1 - \phi_j)] \Big] \\
&+ \sum_{j=1}^J \Big[ -\log B(\alpha_\eta, \beta_\eta) + \log B(a_{\eta_j}, b_{\eta_j}) + (\alpha_\eta - a_{\eta_j})E[\log \eta_j] + (\beta_\eta - b_{\eta_j})E[\log(1 - \eta_j)] \Big] \\
&+ \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{k=1}^K \left[ -\log \Gamma(\alpha_a) + \alpha_a \log \alpha_a + \log \Gamma(a_{a_{ik}}) - a_{a_{ik}} \log b_{a_{ik}} + (\alpha_a - a_{a_{ik}})\left\{\Psi(a_{a_{ik}}) - \log b_{a_{ik}}\right\} - \frac{\alpha_a a_{a_{ik}}}{b_{a_{ik}}} + a_{a_{ik}} \right].
\end{aligned}
$$
